name: usage-hud
description: Three-box HUD above the prompt: tokens and API-equivalent cost across all sessions (daily and per-session breakdown), context-window meter with a soft limit, and prompt-cache warmth countdown with last-turn tokens and cost.

context_soft_limit.title: Context soft limit (tokens)
context_soft_limit.description: Context use past this mark is shaded gray as not optimal. Default 240000.

history_days.title: Days in the daily chart
history_days.description: How many days the breakdown chart shows. Default 30.

live_seconds.title: Tick the cache countdown every second
live_seconds.description: Redraw the band each second while the cache counts down. Turn off to update once a minute if your Desktop build flickers.

cache_guard.title: Ask when the prompt cache has expired
cache_guard.description: Before the first prompt after the cache expires, ask whether to continue in the same session. Also switchable from the HUD or with /usage-hud guard on|off.
